title: Translation and dilation of contract varifolds (fact Inv)
statement: Let U be open in R^(n+l), V = v(M, theta) a contract rectifiable n-varifold in U with weight mu, c in R^(n+l) and R > 0; put psi(x) := c + R x and U' := psi^-1(U). Then there is a contract rectifiable n-varifold V' in U' with carrier psi^-1(M), multiplicity theta o psi, weight R^-n (phi_# mu) where phi(y) := R^-1 (y - c), support psi^-1(spt V), tangent projections V'.tangentProj x = V.tangentProj (psi x) for every x, and such that whenever V has generalized mean curvature H in U, V' has generalized mean curvature x -> R H(psi x) in U'.
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (U : Set (Amb n ℓ)), IsOpen U → ∀ (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ U) (c : Amb n ℓ) (R : ℝ), 0 < R → ∃ V' : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ ((fun x => c + R • x) ⁻¹' U), V'.carrier = (fun x => c + R • x) ⁻¹' V.carrier ∧ (∀ x, V'.mult x = V.mult (c + R • x)) ∧ V'.weight = (ENNReal.ofReal (R ^ n))⁻¹ • V.weight.map (fun x => R⁻¹ • (x - c)) ∧ V'.support = (fun x => c + R • x) ⁻¹' V.support ∧ (∀ x, V'.tangentProj x = V.tangentProj (c + R • x)) ∧ ∀ H : Amb n ℓ → Amb n ℓ, V.HasGeneralizedMeanCurvature H → V'.HasGeneralizedMeanCurvature (fun x => R • H (c + R • x))
